lessons_used: Predictions generally overestimate noise-corrected outcomes, though winning tests frequently exceed expected gains.
Finish hints were helpful, winning in two out of three tests.
Choose path hints showed no positive effect across five tests.
Adoption layout changes showed no positive effect across two tests.
Home notifications showed no clear effect across two tests.
Evidence remains thin for kinds of changes tested only once.

candidates.title: Centered Layout Home Intro Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the home_intro screen into a centered layout highlighting essential desktop pet interaction controls.
candidates.why: Support receives multiple emails regarding confusion on how to control or hide pets after setup; a centered layout focuses attention directly on core controls.

home_intro.headline: Your Companion is Ready on Your Desktop
home_intro.body: Use quick shortcuts to talk, pin, or hide your companion anytime while working.

guard.reason: Redesigning the home intro overlay layout inside onboarding is permitted by Rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Finish step loses 19% of users and support emails report control confusion; finish redesigns show modest positive lift (+1.0% across 5 tests) but require redesign work.

candidates.title: Reorder Sign-In After Pick Friend Screen
candidates.change: Move the sign-in step to occur immediately after friend selection, allowing users to pick a companion before creating an account.
candidates.why: Selecting a pet companion early builds emotional connection before prompting for account creation, reducing early drop-offs.

candidates.title: Pet Visibility Controls New Screen
candidates.change: Introduce a dedicated screen 'new_pet_visibility_guide' before home intro explaining system tray and desktop dock controls.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets highlighted confusion over how to summon, minimize, or hide pets once onboarding finishes.

new_pet_visibility_guide.headline: Managing Your Desktop Companion
new_pet_visibility_guide.body: Learn how to minimize, show, or dock your pet on your computer screen.

components.text: Right-click the desktop pet or system tray icon anytime for instant controls.

guard.reason: new screens need an _order that places them

candidates.title: Pet Starter Accessory Selection Sub-Flow
candidates.change: Add a new sub-flow screen 'new_accessory_selector' where users pick an initial desktop toy or hat before certificate creation.
candidates.why: Increasing user personalization during adoption boosts adoption completion and user investment.

new_accessory_selector.headline: Pick Your Pet's First Desktop Toy
new_accessory_selector.body: Choose a starting toy that will appear next to your pet on your desktop.

guard.reason: new screens need an _order that places them

candidates.title: Choose Path Freedom Copy Update
candidates.change: Update headline and body copy on choose_path screen to emphasize that users can change or customize their setup path later.
candidates.why: Choose path has a high mean completion time (514s), showing users stall due to decision hesitation.

choose_path.headline: Select How You Want to Start
choose_path.body: Choose a preset or custom path to begin. You can switch modes or customize features anytime in settings.

guard.reason: Updated copy preserves the core job of offering both preset (adopt) and custom (make your own) paths.

candidates.score_note: Choose path has high drop-off and duration, though evidence is mostly funnel-based; choose_path copy changes show weak historical gains (+0.2%).

candidates.title: Sign-In Existing Pet Sync Reassurance Component
candidates.change: Add a clear text component on the sign-in screen reassuring returning users that signing in restores previous pets and progress.
candidates.why: 8 support emails (the top support theme) complained about missing pets or reset data after signing back in.

components.text: Already adopted a pet? Sign into your existing account to automatically restore all saved pets.

guard.reason: Adding account restoration reassurance text to the sign-in screen is permitted.

candidates.score_note: Top support theme (8 emails) targets sign-in data reset fears; sign_in copy changes historically show slight negative average, but copy change is cheap and highly relevant to feedback.

candidates.title: Waiting Screen Desktop Companion Loading Explanation
candidates.change: Update headline and body on the waiting screen to clarify that the system is building the desktop pet window overlay.
candidates.why: 3 support emails reported pets failing to appear on the desktop; setting clear expectations during loading reduces user anxiety.

waiting.headline: Preparing Desktop Pet Window
waiting.body: Creating your desktop companion overlay. Your pet will launch on your screen in a moment.

guard.reason: Updated waiting screen copy maintains its job of showing the pet is being created.

candidates.score_note: Home step has lower drop-off (7.9%), but wait_info changes have a highly reliable track record (+0.4% over 13 tests) and directly address reported support issues.

candidates.title: Two Column Photo Upload Screen Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the photo upload step into a two-column layout separating photo selection from live pet preview display.
candidates.why: Support reported 3 custom pet creation issues; cleaner visual separation helps users upload and verify custom pet photos correctly.

upload_photos.headline: Design Your Custom Desktop Pet
upload_photos.body: Upload a photo to build a customized companion for your desktop.

guard.reason: Redesigning the photo upload screen into a two-column layout is permitted by Rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Adoption step loses 18.1% of users and support reports photo issues; adoption redesigns consistently perform well (+1.1% across 7 tests), though cost is high.

candidates.title: Desktop Pet Drag and Drop Positioning Hint
candidates.change: Add a visual hint to the home intro screen showing users how to click and drag their pet anywhere on screen.
candidates.why: Users reported confusion regarding how to position or interact with their pet on the desktop post-onboarding.

home_intro.hint: Tip: Click and drag your pet anywhere on your desktop screen to reposition it.

guard.reason: Adding a drag-and-drop hint component to the home intro overlay is permitted by Rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Finish hints are proven winners (+4.0% across 3 tests, winning 2/3) and directly address user confusion noted in support complaints.

candidates.title: Stage Layout Story Introduction Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the story introduction screen into a stage layout highlighting key features in a framed showcase.
candidates.why: A stage layout creates a polished initial impression, encouraging users to progress into path selection.

story.headline: Meet Your Virtual Desktop Companion
story.body: Bring interactive pets, custom routines, and fun directly to your desktop workspace.

guard.reason: Redesigned stage layout story screen continues to fulfill its job of introducing the pet.

candidates.score_note: Choose path step drops 20.6%, but choose_path redesigns historically perform poorly (-1.6% across 3 tests) and lack direct support mail evidence.
